verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy axis for a SaaS issue tracker like Linear. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, or usage-tracking controls. The privacy-adjacent items (private teams, Okta access, third-party app approvals) are different features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
